channel.title: Farrelly Atkinson Limited - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Farrelly Atkinson Limited (road.cc)

item.title: Giant finalises refunds to migrant workers, after Trump administration blocked imports of brand's bikes over forced labour allegations
item.description: Giant says corrective plan "on schedule" and it "remains committed to further strengthening systems that protect migrant worker rights"

item.title: Driver who hit group of cyclists on country lane cleared of causing death by careless driving, after defence lawyer argues "position of cyclists" was cause of crash
item.description: Jury found accountancy chief Thomas Gibbs not guilty following just over an hour of deliberation, the trial having previously heard he had told the cyclists he was 'late for his children's nanny'

item.title: Film your rides like a Tour de France winner: Insta 360's Tadej Pogačar camera + could your next road bike be... a Ducati?!
item.description: All the hottest new tech we've spotted this week, including stuff from Ducati, Polygon, Muc-Off, Strava, Bianchi and more

item.title: All That Matters by Sir Chris Hoy
item.description: If helping people to understand more about cancer is a good thing, Hoy's participation will help to raise awareness 10/10

item.title: Topeak Turbo Morph With Gauge pump
item.description: Big pump with a big spec, but doesn't quite pull it all off – and can painfully trap knuckles while it's at it 5/10

item.title: How did he keep that up?! Mathieu van der Poel's incredible crash save caught on camera
item.description: Training sprint almost ends in disaster...

item.title: Cheating on Zwift with an exoskeleton: is this the future of assisted cycling?
item.description: I was keen to find out if an exoskeleton can compensate for my lack of fitness...

item.title: Are cyclists in Scotland any closer to being able to submit dangerous driving footage to an online police portal?
item.description: After years of delays and inaction, cyclists in Scotland feel left behind England and Wales and fear the lack of an online reporting portal has put lives at risk

item.title: Canyon Citylite:ON
item.description: Impressive, low maintenance, high performance city bike, undermined by a problematic front light 7/10

item.title: A beautiful Colnago track bike built to Eddy Merckx's 1972 Hour Record dimensions
item.description: While Tadej Pogačar's Tour-winning Y1Rs selling for almost $200,000 made the big headlines this week, this restored Colnago also went under the hammer
